text:
Redwood Incident Bot: :rotating_light: Pager: HIGH severity — Bluecrest (private VPC) auth failures in us-east-1. Token exchange / introspection returning 500/401 for multiple tenants. Bridge: https://call.redwood/bridge/bluecrest-2251234567

Maya R: I'm on the pager.

Liam C: joining the bridge, grabbing logs now.

Sophia K: seeing repeated `kid` mismatch errors in token validation logs. Looks like JWKS keys rolled but our proxy still using cached JWKS. Example:
```
2026-03-15T12:34:10Z auth-proxy[pid=2345]: token_validate: jwt: signature verification failed (kid "k9876" not found in jwks)
2026-03-15T12:34:11Z auth-proxy[pid=2345]: jwks_fetch: 200 OK, keys=3, cache_ttl=3600s
```

Devin P: Bluecrest said they rotated keys around 12:30 but upload may have been incomplete. Could be JWKS propagation + proxy cache TTL. Any caches in our VPC edge?

Alex G: yes, edge proxies in dedicated pool keep a 1h JWKS cache by default. We can trigger a cache purge via admin endpoint: `POST /internal/admin/jwks/purge?tenant=bluecrest`

Rachel (CS): Bluecrest impact — customer reports that internal services (payment, user-auth) are failing intermittently. They say ~12 services, impact started ~12:33, affecting 30% of requests. Customer oncall is available on bridge: bluecrest-oncall.

bluecrest-oncall (external): We did rotate keys but pushed twice, second push failed with HTTP 502 from our CI. Can you accept an immediate manual JWKS override while we fix our CI? We can provide the key set.

Liam C: ok, short-term mitigation: apply JWKS override to their tenant until they re-push. Steps:
1) upload provided JWKS to S3 location for overrides
2) call admin API: `PUT /api/v1/tenants/bluecrest/jwks_override` with payload
3) purge proxy cache

Sophia K: I'm pushing a temporary override now. Payload validated locally.

Devin P: while that's happening, we should reduce jwks_cache_ttl to 60s on edge to avoid further stale cache issues. Alex, can you patch the config for the bluecrest route in dedicated pool?

Alex G: doing `kubectl patch` to update config map `auth-edge-config` in namespace `dedicated-bluecrest`. Command:
```
kubectl -n dedicated-bluecrest patch configmap auth-edge-config --type merge -p '{"data":{"jwks_cache_ttl":"60"}}'
```

Alex G: patch applied. Rolling restart of proxy pods initiated: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/auth-proxy` (pods are coming back up)

Redwood Incident Bot: :white_check_mark: Admin jwks_override applied by Sophia K at 12:42Z. Proxy cache purge triggered.

Maya R: monitoring latency/error rates. Initial saw 401s drop from 30% -> 8% in last 5m.

Rachel (CS): Notifying Bluecrest product leads. They requested ETA to full recovery and a post-incident summary.

bluecrest-oncall (external): Confirming override worked for our current token issuer. We're re-running CI to re-push; will update in 10m.

Liam C: TODOs: (1) keep override for up to 2 hours, (2) follow up with eng-runtime for improving JWKS propagation heuristics, (3) engage Dedicated infra for increasing cache invalidation controls per-tenant.

Sophia K: creating incident ticket: INC-2251234567

Devin P: flagging possible root cause: simultaneous key rotation + failed CI push -> partial jwks published -> proxy cached old set leading to kid mismatch. Longer-term fix: accept `kid` discovery tolerant behavior or add JWKS handshake to validation fallback.

Alex G: opened ENG-RUNTIME ticket to evaluate best path (rotate keystore atomically, incremental keys with staged rollout). Reference: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENGR-7381

Redwood Incident Bot: :rotating_light: Pager resolved (mitigated) at 12:52Z. Monitoring for 30m.

Maya R: handoff to overnight oncall: @Liam C will do a quick sync with next oncall. Liam, please ack.

Liam C: ack. Leaving bridge, will follow up in #incidents-summary with final postmortem.

Rachel (CS): Customer confirms services are back to normal. They'll coordinate re-deploy once CI fixed. We'll schedule a post-mortem with Bluecrest SRE tomorrow.

bluecrest-oncall (external): Thanks team. We'll share our CI logs in the bridge channel.

Sophia K: post-incident notes: affected tenants=bluecrest-private-1; mitigation=JWKS override + cache_ttl patch; duration ~19m; action items created (ENG-RUNTIME, dedicated infra, CS follow-up).

Devin P: closing bridge. Please add any remaining notes to INC-2251234567.

Redwood Incident Bot: Incident INC-2251234567 marked MITIGATED by Sophia K.
